content.title: Valero Texas Open - Champions fore Charity
content.text: Details For Charity Incentives Drawing fore More Awareness · $15,000 Based on commitment amounts raised and submitted within the incentive window, participating organizations receive a designated number of entries into the current drawing. One (1) random organization will be drawn and selected during a Facebook video with one of the program Ambassadors. The winning organization will earn $2,500 and will also be featured in one (1) dedicated social media post on the Champions fore Charity Facebook page. The contest starts fresh and new for each of the six (6) drawings. No charity can win more than one drawing. Submission of donation forms to Valero Texas Open staff are accepted via mail, email, in person, and online. Amount Raised# Entries $500 - $5,0001 $5,001 - $10,0003 $10,001 - $30,0005 $30,001 - $50,00010 $50,001 - $100,00015 $100,001 - $200,00020 $200,001+25 EMCOR Industrial Services Pro-Am Charity Challenge · $50,000 Based upon the deadline of March 2, 2026, total commitment amounts for each organization will be tabulated. The “Great 48”* organizations will be comprised of the top four (4) with the highest commitment amounts within each of the twelve (12) peer groups^. In the event of a tie within a peer group, the date(s) of submission to reach the current commitment total will be used to determine the tie-breaker; so the sooner the commitments are received, it aids in securing the ranking. Each organization will be represented by an amateur team playing in the EMCOR Industrial Services Pro-Am. The “Great 48”* organizations will automatically earn $700. However, the top 3 pro-am teams (based on the teams’ performances) will instead earn their respective charity: 1st Place: $10,000 2nd Place: $5,500 3rd Place: $3,000 ^ Peer Groups are based on annual operating budgets (provided by charities at time of registration). * Based on actual number of teams in the pro-am, the top three (3) from each peer group is guaranteed a pro-am team assignment; the fourth place within each peer group may or may not be assigned a team. Peer GroupAnnual Operating Budget A$1k - $19k B$20k - $49k C$50k - $100k D$100k - $249k E$250k - $499k F$500k - $999k G$1M - $3M H$4M - $9M I$10M - $20M J$21M - $49M K$50M - $100M L$101M+ Matching Gift Incentive Through tournament proceeds, the Valero Texas Open will match 7% of your total fundraising collected amount. It will be automatically awarded based on reaching the minimum collections of $1,000. The incentive amount funded has a cap of $10,000 per an organization. (i.e. Collect $143,000 + 7% match (=$10,010) $10,000 max = $153,000) Guess The Champion Contest · $5,000 Donors have the opportunity to guess who the 2026 Valero Texas Open Champion will be for a chance to win a Stay & Play Gift Package to TPC San Antonio and the JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort. Participating donors who have provided an email address will receive an email from tournament officials allowing them to select from the player field who they believe will win the tournament. The winner will be drawn from those who correctly guessed the tournament champion and receive the grand prize, along with earning the benefiting charity a donation of $5,000. If the winner donated to multiple organizations, the incentive contribution will be split evenly amongst the charitable recipients selected by the donor.
